page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c8g1.14xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance designed for parallel computing workloads. Running on the KVM hypervisor with an x86_64 CPU architecture, this instance features 54 dedicated vCPUs and 480.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 8.89 GB of RAM per core.

The instance is equipped with eight NVIDIA P100 GPUs, providing a combined total of 128 GB of VRAM. For local data requirements, it includes 3779 GB of bundled SSD storage. Network connectivity is supported by a 25 Gbps baseline bandwidth, facilitating high-speed data transfers between nodes.

From a resource density perspective, this server offers a high concentration of GPU accelerators and local SSD capacity, making it a viable option for legacy GPU-accelerated workloads, deep learning training, and scientific simulations. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance without resource contention, though the older GPU architecture represents a tradeoff compared to newer accelerator generations.
